name: Highcharts--charts
title: charts
description: An array containing the current chart objects in the page. A chart's position in the array is preserved throughout the page's lifetime. When a chart is destroyed, the array item becomes undefined.

name: Highcharts--dateFormats
title: dateFormats
description: A hook for defining additional date format specifiers. New specifiers are defined as key-value pairs by using the specifier as key, and a function which takes the timestamp as value. This function returns the formatted portion of the date. Using dateFormats is also a convenient way to define new keys for complex locale-aware date formats compatible with the Intl.DateTimeFormat browser API, whenever the built-in formats are not sufficient.

name: Highcharts--defaultOptions
title: defaultOptions
description: Global default settings.

name: Highcharts--maps
title: maps
description: Contains all loaded map data for Highmaps.

name: Highcharts--sonification
title: sonification
description: Global Sonification classes and objects.

name: Highcharts--theme
title: theme
description: Theme options that should get applied to the chart. In module mode it might not be possible to change this property because of read-only restrictions, instead use Highcharts.setOptions.

name: Highcharts--addEvent
title: addEvent
params: (Object el, String type, Function fn, [Object options])
description: Add an event listener.

name: Highcharts--ajax
title: ajax
description: Perform an Ajax call.

name: Highcharts--animObject
title: animObject
description: Get the animation in object form, where a disabled animation is always returned as { duration: 0 }.

name: Highcharts--animate
title: animate
description: The global animate method, which uses Fx to create individual animators.

name: Highcharts--arrayMax
title: arrayMax
description: Non-recursive method to find the lowest member of an array. Math.max raises a maximum call stack size exceeded error in Chrome when trying to apply more than 150.000 points. This method is slightly slower, but safe.

name: Highcharts--arrayMin
title: arrayMin
description: Non-recursive method to find the lowest member of an array. Math.min raises a maximum call stack size exceeded error in Chrome when trying to apply more than 150.000 points. This method is slightly slower, but safe.

name: Highcharts--attr
title: attr
description: Set or get an attribute or an object of attributes. To use as a setter, pass a key and a value, or let the second argument be a collection of keys and values. When using a collection, passing a value of null or undefined will remove the attribute. To use as a getter, pass only a string as the second argument.

name: Highcharts--chart
title: chart
description: Factory function for basic charts.

name: Highcharts--color
title: color
description: Creates a color instance out of a color string.

name: Highcharts--correctFloat
title: correctFloat
description: Fix JS round off float errors.

name: Highcharts--createElement
title: createElement
description: Utility function to create an HTML element with attributes and styles.

name: Highcharts--css
title: css
description: Set CSS on a given element.

name: Highcharts--data
title: data
description: Creates a data object to parse data for a chart.

name: Highcharts--defined
title: defined
description: Check if an object is null or undefined.

name: Highcharts--destroyObjectProperties
title: destroyObjectProperties
description: Utility method that destroys any SVGElement instances that are properties on the given object. It loops all properties and invokes destroy if there is a destroy method. The property is then delete.

name: Highcharts--discardElement
title: discardElement
description: Discard a HTML element

name: Highcharts--downloadSVGLocal
title: downloadSVGLocal
description: Deprecated. Use Exporting.downloadSVG instead. Get data URL to an image of an SVG and call download on it options object: filename: Name of resulting downloaded file without extension. Default is chart. type: File type of resulting download. Default is image/png. scale: Scaling factor of downloaded image compared to source. Default is 1. libURL: URL pointing to location of dependency scripts to download on demand.

name: Highcharts--erase
title: erase
description: Remove the last occurrence of an item from an array.

name: Highcharts--error
title: error
description: Provide error messages for debugging, with links to online explanation. This function can be overridden to provide custom error handling.

name: Highcharts--extend
title: extend
description: Utility function to extend an object with the members of another.

name: Highcharts--extendClass
title: extendClass
description: Extend a prototyped class by new members.

name: Highcharts--find
title: find
description: Return the value of the first element in the array that satisfies the provided testing function.

name: Highcharts--fireEvent
title: fireEvent
description: Fire an event that was registered with Highcharts#addEvent.

name: Highcharts--ganttChart
title: ganttChart
description: The factory function for creating new gantt charts. Creates a new GanttChart object with different default options than the basic Chart.

name: Highcharts--geojson
title: geojson
description: Highcharts Maps only. Restructure a GeoJSON or TopoJSON object in preparation to be read directly by the series.mapData option. The object will be broken down to fit a specific Highcharts type, either map, mapline or mappoint. Meta data in GeoJSON's properties object will be copied directly over to Highcharts.Point.properties in Highcharts Maps.

name: Highcharts--getDeferredAnimation
title: getDeferredAnimation
description: Get the defer as a number value from series animation options.

name: Highcharts--getJSON
title: getJSON
description: Get a JSON resource over XHR, also supporting CORS without preflight.

name: Highcharts--getMagnitude
title: getMagnitude
description: Get the magnitude of a number.

name: Highcharts--getOptions
title: getOptions
description: Get the updated default options. Until 3.0.7, merely exposing defaultOptions for outside modules wasn't enough because the setOptions method created a new object.

name: Highcharts--getStyle
title: getStyle
description: Get the computed CSS value for given element and property, only for numerical properties. For width and height, the dimension of the inner box (excluding padding) is returned. Used for fitting the chart within the container.

name: Highcharts--hasWebGLSupport
title: hasWebGLSupport
description: Returns true if the current browser supports WebGL.

name: Highcharts--i18nFormat
title: i18nFormat
description: i18n formatting function. Extends Highcharts.format() functionality by also handling arrays and plural conditionals. Arrays can be indexed as follows: Format: 'This is the first index: {myArray[0]}. The last: {myArray[-1]}.' Context: { myArray: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5] } Result: 'This is the first index: 0. The last: 5.' They can also be iterated using the #each() function. This will repeat the contents of the bracket expression for each element. Example: Format: 'List contains: {#each(myArray)cm }' Context: { myArray: [0, 1, 2] } Result: 'List contains: 0cm 1cm 2cm ' The #each() function optionally takes a length parameter. If positive, this parameter specifies the max number of elements to iterate through. If negative, the function will subtract the number from the length of the array. Use this to stop iterating before the array ends. Example: Format: 'List contains: {#each(myArray, -1), }and {myArray[-1]}.' Context: { myArray: [0, 1, 2, 3] } Result: 'List contains: 0, 1, 2, and 3.' Use the #plural() function to pick a string depending on whether or not a context object is 1. Arguments are #plural(obj, plural, singular). Example: Format: 'Has {numPoints} {#plural(numPoints, points, point}.' Context: { numPoints: 5 } Result: 'Has 5 points.' Optionally there are additional parameters for dual and none: #plural(obj, plural, singular, dual, none). Example: Format: 'Has {#plural(numPoints, many points, one point, two points, none}.' Context: { numPoints: 2 } Result: 'Has two points.' The dual or none parameters will take precedence if they are supplied.

name: Highcharts--isArray
title: isArray
description: Utility function to check if an item is an array.

name: Highcharts--isClass
title: isClass
description: Utility function to check if an Object is a class.

name: Highcharts--isDOMElement
title: isDOMElement
description: Utility function to check if an Object is a HTML Element.

name: Highcharts--isFunction
title: isFunction
description: Utility function to check if object is a function.

name: Highcharts--isNumber
title: isNumber
description: Utility function to check if an item is a number and it is finite (not NaN, Infinity or -Infinity).

name: Highcharts--isObject
title: isObject
description: Utility function to check if an item is of type object.

name: Highcharts--isString
title: isString
description: Utility function to check for string type.

name: Highcharts--mapChart
title: mapChart
description: The factory function for creating new map charts. Creates a new MapChart object with different default options than the basic Chart.

name: Highcharts--merge
title: merge
description: Utility function to deep merge two or more objects and return a third object. If the first argument is true, the contents of the second object is copied into the first object. The merge function can also be used with a single object argument to create a deep copy of an object.

name: Highcharts--navigator
title: navigator
description: Factory function for standalone navigator.

name: Highcharts--normalizeTickInterval
title: normalizeTickInterval
description: Take an interval and normalize it to multiples of round numbers.

name: Highcharts--objectEach
title: objectEach
description: Iterate over object key pairs in an object.

name: Highcharts--offset
title: offset
description: Get the element's offset position, corrected for overflow: auto.

name: Highcharts--pad
title: pad
description: Left-pad a string to a given length by adding a character repetitively.

name: Highcharts--pick
title: pick
description: Return the first value that is not null or undefined.

name: Highcharts--relativeLength
title: relativeLength
description: Return a length based on either the integer value, or a percentage of a base.

name: Highcharts--removeEvent
title: removeEvent
description: Remove an event that was added with Highcharts#addEvent.

name: Highcharts--setAnimation
title: setAnimation
description: Set the global animation to either a given value, or fall back to the given chart's animation option.

name: Highcharts--setOptions
title: setOptions
description: Merge the default options with custom options and return the new options structure. Commonly used for defining reusable templates.

name: Highcharts--splat
title: splat
description: Check if an element is an array, and if not, make it into an array.

name: Highcharts--splitPath
title: splitPath
description: Utility for reading SVG paths directly.

name: Highcharts--stableSort
title: stableSort
description: Sort an object array and keep the order of equal items. The ECMAScript standard does not specify the behavior when items are equal.

name: Highcharts--stockChart
title: stockChart
description: Factory function for creating new stock charts. Creates a new StockChart object with different default options than the basic Chart.

name: Highcharts--stop
title: stop
description: Stop running animation.

name: Highcharts--syncTimeout
title: syncTimeout
description: Set a timeout if the delay is given, otherwise perform the function synchronously.

name: Highcharts--uniqueKey
title: uniqueKey
description: Get a unique key for using in internal element id's and pointers. The key is composed of a random hash specific to this Highcharts instance, and a counter.

name: Highcharts--useSerialIds
title: useSerialIds
description: Activates a serial mode for element IDs provided by Highcharts.uniqueKey. This mode can be used in automated tests, where a simple comparison of two rendered SVG graphics is needed. Note: This is only for testing purposes and will break functionality in webpages with multiple charts.

name: Highcharts--wrap
title: wrap
description: Wrap a method with extended functionality, preserving the original function.

name: Axis--categories
title: categories
description: If categories are present for the axis, names are used instead of numbers for that axis. Since Highcharts 3.0, categories can also be extracted by giving each point a name and setting axis type to category. However, if you have multiple series, best practice remains defining the categories array.

name: Axis--chart
title: chart
description: The Chart that the axis belongs to.

name: Axis--coll
title: coll
description: The collection where the axis belongs, for example xAxis, yAxis or colorAxis. Corresponds to properties on Chart, for example Highcharts.Chart.xAxis.

name: Axis--crosshair
title: crosshair
description: The processed crosshair options.

name: Axis--horiz
title: horiz
description: Whether the axis is horizontal.

name: Axis--isXAxis
title: isXAxis
description: Whether the axis is the x-axis.

name: Axis--len
title: len
description: The length of the axis in terms of pixels.

name: Axis--max
title: max
description: The maximum value of the axis. In a logarithmic axis, this is the logarithm of the real value, and the real value can be obtained from Highcharts.Axis#getExtremes.

name: Axis--min
title: min
description: The minimum value of the axis. In a logarithmic axis, this is the logarithm of the real value, and the real value can be obtained from Highcharts.Axis#getExtremes.

name: Axis--minorTicks
title: minorTicks
description: List of minor ticks mapped by position on the axis.

name: Axis--options
title: options
description: Current options for the axis after merge of defaults and user's options.

name: Axis--pos
title: pos
description: The position of the axis in terms of pixels, compared to the chart edge. In a horizontal axis it is the same as chart.plotLeft unless the axis is explicitly positioned, and in a default vertical axis it is the same as chart.plotTop.

name: Axis--reversed
title: reversed
description: Whether the axis is reversed. Based on the axis.reversed, option, but inverted charts have reversed xAxis by default.

name: Axis--series
title: series
description: All series associated to the axis.

name: Axis--side
title: side
description: The side on which the axis is rendered. 0 is top, 1 is right, 2 is bottom and 3 is left.

name: Axis--tickPositions
title: tickPositions
description: Contains the current positions that are laid out on the axis. The positions are numbers in terms of axis values. In a category axis they are integers, in a datetime axis they are also integers, but designating milliseconds. This property is read only - for modifying the tick positions, use the tickPositioner callback or [axis.tickPositions( https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/xAxis.tickPositions) option instead.

name: Axis--ticks
title: ticks
description: List of major ticks mapped by position on axis.

name: Axis--userOptions
title: userOptions
description: User's options for this axis without defaults.

name: Axis--addTitle
title: addTitle
description: Adds the title defined in axis.options.title.

name: Axis--defaultLabelFormatter
title: defaultLabelFormatter
description: The default label formatter. The context is a special config object for the label. In apps, use the labels.formatter instead, except when a modification is needed.

name: Axis--drawCrosshair
title: drawCrosshair
description: Internal function to draw a crosshair.

name: Axis--drilldownCategory
title: drilldownCategory
description: Drill down to a given category. This is the same as clicking on an axis label. If multiple series with drilldown are present, all will drill down to the given category. See also Point.doDrilldown for drilling down on a single point instance.

name: Axis--getExtremes
title: getExtremes
description: Get the current extremes for the axis.

name: Axis--getLinePath
title: getLinePath
description: Internal function to get the path for the axis line. Extended for polar charts.

name: Axis--getLinearTickPositions
title: getLinearTickPositions
description: Internal function to get the tick positions of a linear axis to round values like whole tens or every five.

name: Axis--getMinorTickInterval
title: getMinorTickInterval
description: Resolve the new minorTicks/minorTickInterval options into the legacy loosely typed minorTickInterval option.

name: Axis--getMinorTickPositions
title: getMinorTickPositions
description: Internal function to return the minor tick positions. For logarithmic axes, the same logic as for major ticks is reused.

name: Axis--getPlotBandPath
title: getPlotBandPath
description: Internal function to create the SVG path definition for a plot band.

name: Axis--getPlotLinePath
title: getPlotLinePath
description: Create the path for a plot line that goes from the given value on this axis, across the plot to the opposite side. Also used internally for grid lines and crosshairs.

name: Axis--getThreshold
title: getThreshold
description: Get the zero plane either based on zero or on the min or max value. Used in bar and area plots.

name: Axis--hasData
title: hasData
description: Return true if the axis has associated data.

name: Axis--hideCrosshair
title: hideCrosshair
description: Hide the crosshair if visible.

name: Axis--init
title: init
description: Overridable function to initialize the axis.

name: Axis--remove
title: remove
description: Remove the axis from the chart.

name: Axis--renderLine
title: renderLine
description: Render the axis line. Called internally when rendering and redrawing the axis.

name: Axis--renderMinorTick
title: renderMinorTick
description: Render a minor tick into the given position. If a minor tick already exists in this position, move it.

name: Axis--renderTick
title: renderTick
description: Render a major tick into the given position. If a tick already exists in this position, move it.

name: Axis--setCategories
title: setCategories
description: Set new axis categories and optionally redraw.

name: Axis--setExtremes
title: setExtremes
description: Set the minimum and maximum of the axes after render time. If the startOnTick and endOnTick options are true, the minimum and maximum values are rounded off to the nearest tick. To prevent this, these options can be set to false before calling setExtremes. Also, setExtremes will not allow a range lower than the minRange option, which by default is the range of five points.

name: Axis--setTitle
title: setTitle
description: Update the axis title by options after render time.

name: Axis--toPixels
title: toPixels
description: Translate a value in terms of axis units into pixels within the chart.

name: Axis--toValue
title: toValue
description: Translate a pixel position along the axis to a value in terms of axis units.

name: Axis--update
title: update
description: Update an axis object with a new set of options. The options are merged with the existing options, so only new or altered options need to be specified.

name: Chart--axes
title: axes
description: All the axes in the chart.

name: Chart--chartHeight
title: chartHeight
description: The current pixel height of the chart.

name: Chart--chartWidth
title: chartWidth
description: The current pixel width of the chart.

name: Chart--container
title: container
description: The containing HTML element of the chart. The container is dynamically inserted into the element given as the renderTo parameter in the Highcharts#chart constructor.

name: Chart--credits
title: credits
description: The chart's credits label. The label has an update method that allows setting new options as per the credits options set.

name: Chart--data
title: data
description: The data parser for this chart.

name: Chart--exporting
title: exporting
description: Exporting object.

name: Chart--hoverPoint
title: hoverPoint
description: Contains the original hovered point.

name: Chart--hoverPoints
title: hoverPoints
description: Contains all hovered points.

name: Chart--hoverSeries
title: hoverSeries
description: Contains the original hovered series.

name: Chart--index
title: index
description: Index position of the chart in the Highcharts#charts property.

name: Chart--inverted
title: inverted
description: The flag is set to true if a series of the chart is inverted.

name: Chart--legend
title: legend
description: The legend contains an interactive overview over chart items, usually individual series or points depending on the series type. The color axis and bubble legend are also rendered in the chart legend.

name: Chart--numberFormatter
title: numberFormatter
description: Callback function to override the default function that formats all the numbers in the chart. Returns a string with the formatted number.

name: Chart--options
title: options
description: The options structure for the chart after merging #defaultOptions and #userOptions. It contains members for the sub elements like series, legend, tooltip etc.

name: Chart--plotHeight
title: plotHeight
description: The current height of the plot area in pixels.

name: Chart--plotLeft
title: plotLeft
description: The current left position of the plot area in pixels.

name: Chart--plotTop
title: plotTop
description: The current top position of the plot area in pixels.

name: Chart--plotWidth
title: plotWidth
description: The current width of the plot area in pixels.

name: Chart--pointer
title: pointer
description: The Pointer that keeps track of mouse and touch interaction.

name: Chart--renderer
title: renderer
description: The renderer instance of the chart. Each chart instance has only one associated renderer.

name: Chart--series
title: series
description: All the current series in the chart.

name: Chart--sonification
title: sonification
description: Sonification capabilities for the chart.

name: Chart--styledMode
title: styledMode
description: Whether the chart is in styled mode, meaning all presentational attributes are avoided.

name: Chart--subtitle
title: subtitle
description: The chart subtitle. The subtitle has an update method that allows modifying the options directly or indirectly via chart.update.

name: Chart--time
title: time
description: The Time object associated with the chart. Since v6.0.5, time settings can be applied individually for each chart. If no individual settings apply, the Time object is shared by all instances.

name: Chart--title
title: title
description: The chart title. The title has an update method that allows modifying the options directly or indirectly via chart.update.

name: Chart--tooltip
title: tooltip
description: Tooltip object for points of series.

name: Chart--userOptions
title: userOptions
description: The original options given to the constructor or a chart factory like Highcharts.chart and Highcharts.stockChart. The original options are shallow copied to avoid mutation. The copy, chart.userOptions, may later be mutated to reflect updated options throughout the lifetime of the chart. For collections, like series, xAxis and yAxis, the chart user options should always be reflected by the item user option, so for example the following should always be true: chart.xAxis[0].userOptions === chart.userOptions.xAxis[0]

name: Chart--xAxis
title: xAxis
description: A collection of the X axes in the chart.

name: Chart--yAxis
title: yAxis
description: A collection of the Y axes in the chart.

name: Chart--addAnnotation
title: addAnnotation
description: Add an annotation to the chart after render time.

name: Chart--addAxis
title: addAxis
description: Add an axis to the chart after render time. Note that this method should never be used when adding data synchronously at chart render time, as it adds expense to the calculations and rendering. When adding data at the same time as the chart is initialized, add the axis as a configuration option instead.

name: Chart--addColorAxis
title: addColorAxis
description: Add a color axis to the chart after render time. Note that this method should never be used when adding data synchronously at chart render time, as it adds expense to the calculations and rendering. When adding data at the same time as the chart is initialized, add the axis as a configuration option instead.

name: Chart--addCredits
title: addCredits
description: Set a new credits label for the chart.

name: Chart--addSeries
title: addSeries
description: Add a series to the chart after render time. Note that this method should never be used when adding data synchronously at chart render time, as it adds expense to the calculations and rendering. When adding data at the same time as the chart is initialized, add the series as a configuration option instead. With multiple axes, the offset is dynamically adjusted.

name: Chart--addSeriesAsDrilldown
title: addSeriesAsDrilldown
description: Add a series to the chart as drilldown from a specific point in the parent series. This method is used for async drilldown, when clicking a point in a series should result in loading and displaying a more high-resolution series. When not async, the setup is simpler using the drilldown.series options structure.

name: Chart--destroy
title: destroy
description: Remove the chart and purge memory. This method is called internally before adding a second chart into the same container, as well as on window unload to prevent leaks.

name: Chart--drillUp
title: drillUp
description: When the chart is drilled down to a child series, calling chart.drillUp() will drill up to the parent series.

name: Chart--fromLatLonToPoint
title: fromLatLonToPoint
description: Deprecated. Use MapView.lonLatToProjectedUnits instead.

name: Chart--fromPointToLatLon
title: fromPointToLatLon
description: Deprecated. Use MapView.projectedUnitsToLonLat instead.

name: Chart--get
title: get
description: Get an axis, series or point object by id as given in the configuration options. Returns undefined if no item is found.

name: Chart--getOptions
title: getOptions
description: Return the current options of the chart, but only those that differ from default options. Items that can be either an object or an array of objects, like series, xAxis and yAxis, are always returned as array.

name: Chart--getSelectedPoints
title: getSelectedPoints
description: Returns an array of all currently selected points in the chart. Points can be selected by clicking or programmatically by the Highcharts.Point#select function.

name: Chart--getSelectedSeries
title: getSelectedSeries
description: Returns an array of all currently selected series in the chart. Series can be selected either programmatically by the Highcharts.Series#select function or by checking the checkbox next to the legend item if series.showCheckBox is true.

name: Chart--hideLoading
title: hideLoading
description: Hide the loading layer.

name: Chart--init
title: init
description: Overridable function that initializes the chart. The constructor's arguments are passed on directly.

name: Chart--isInsidePlot
title: isInsidePlot
description: Check whether a given point is within the plot area.

name: Chart--langFormat
title: langFormat
description: Apply context to a format string from lang options of the chart.

name: Chart--mapZoom
title: mapZoom
description: Highcharts Maps only. Zoom in or out of the map. See also Highcharts.Point#zoomTo. See Highcharts.Chart#fromLatLonToPoint for how to get the centerX and centerY parameters for a geographic location. Deprecated as of v9.3 in favor of MapView.zoomBy.

name: Chart--redraw
title: redraw
description: Redraw the chart after changes have been done to the data, axis extremes chart size or chart elements. All methods for updating axes, series or points have a parameter for redrawing the chart. This is true by default. But in many cases you want to do more than one operation on the chart before redrawing, for example add a number of points. In those cases it is a waste of resources to redraw the chart for each new point added. So you add the points and call chart.redraw() after.

name: Chart--reflow
title: reflow
description: Reflows the chart to its container. By default, the Resize Observer is attached to the chart's div which allows to reflows the chart automatically to its container, as per the chart.reflow option.

name: Chart--removeAnnotation
title: removeAnnotation
description: Remove an annotation from the chart.

name: Chart--setCaption
title: setCaption
description: Set the caption options. This can also be done from Highcharts.Chart#update.

name: Chart--setClassName
title: setClassName
description: Set the chart container's class name, in addition to highcharts-container.

name: Chart--setSize
title: setSize
description: Resize the chart to a given width and height. In order to set the width only, the height argument may be skipped. To set the height only, pass undefined for the width.

name: Chart--setSubtitle
title: setSubtitle
description: Shortcut to set the subtitle options. This can also be done from Highcharts.Chart#update or Highcharts.Chart#setTitle.

name: Chart--setTitle
title: setTitle
description: Set a new title or subtitle for the chart.

name: Chart--showLoading
title: showLoading
description: Dim the chart and show a loading text or symbol. Options for the loading screen are defined in the loading options.

name: Chart--showResetZoom
title: showResetZoom
description: Display the zoom button, so users can reset zoom to the default view settings.

name: Chart--sonify
title: sonify
description: Play a sonification of a chart.

name: Chart--toggleSonify
title: toggleSonify
description: Play/pause sonification of a chart.

name: Chart--transformFromLatLon
title: transformFromLatLon
description: Highcharts Maps only. Get point from latitude and longitude using specified transform definition.

name: Chart--transformToLatLon
title: transformToLatLon
description: Highcharts Maps only. Get latLon from point using specified transform definition. The method returns an object with the numeric properties lat and lon.

name: Chart--update
title: update
description: A generic function to update any element of the chart. Elements can be enabled and disabled, moved, re-styled, re-formatted etc. A special case is configuration objects that take arrays, for example xAxis, yAxis or series. For these collections, an id option is used to map the new option set to an existing object. If an existing object of the same id is not found, the corresponding item is updated. So for example, running chart.update with a series item without an id, will cause the existing chart's series with the same index in the series array to be updated. When the oneToOne parameter is true, chart.update will also take care of adding and removing items from the collection. Read more under the parameter description below. Note that when changing series data, chart.update may mutate the passed data options. If the given options don't differ from the current chart options, the update is skipped and the afterUpdate event is not emitted. See also the responsive option set. Switching between responsive.rules basically runs chart.update under the hood.

name: Chart--zoomOut
title: zoomOut
description: Zoom the chart out after a user has zoomed in. See also Axis.setExtremes.

name: Legend--allItems
title: allItems
description: All items for the legend, which is an array of series for most series and an array of points for pie series and its derivatives.

name: Legend--box
title: box
description: SVG element of the legend box.

name: Legend--chart
title: chart
description: Chart of this legend.

name: Legend--group
title: group
description: SVG group of the legend.

name: Legend--options
title: options
description: Legend options.

name: Legend--title
title: title
description: SVG element of the legend title.

name: Legend--setText
title: setText
description: Set the legend item text.

name: Legend--update
title: update
description: Update the legend with new options. Equivalent to running chart.update with a legend configuration option.

name: Point--category
title: category
description: For categorized axes this property holds the category name for the point. For other axes it holds the X value.

name: Point--color
title: color
description: The point's current color.

name: Point--colorIndex
title: colorIndex
description: The point's current color index, used in styled mode instead of color. The color index is inserted in class names used for styling.

name: Point--dataGroup
title: dataGroup
description: Highcharts Stock only. If a point object is created by data grouping, it doesn't reflect actual points in the raw data. In this case, the dataGroup property holds information that points back to the raw data. dataGroup.start is the index of the first raw data point in the group. dataGroup.length is the amount of points in the group.

name: Point--graphic
title: graphic
description: SVG graphic representing the point in the chart. In some cases it may be a hidden graphic to improve accessibility. Typically this is a simple shape, like a rect for column charts or path for line markers, but for some complex series types like boxplot or 3D charts, the graphic may be a g element containing other shapes. The graphic is generated the first time Highcharts.Series#drawPoints runs, and updated and moved on subsequent runs.

name: Point--graphics
title: graphics
description: Array for multiple SVG graphics representing the point in the chart. Only used in cases where the point can not be represented by a single graphic.

name: Point--high
title: high
description: Range series only. The high or maximum value for each data point.

name: Point--index
title: index
description: Contains the point's index in the Series.points array.

name: Point--key
title: key
description: The point's name if it is defined, or its category in case of a category, otherwise the x value. Convenient for tooltip and data label formatting.

name: Point--low
title: low
description: Range series only. The low or minimum value for each data point.

name: Point--name
title: name
description: The name of the point. The name can be given as the first position of the point configuration array, or as a name property in the configuration:

name: Point--options
title: options
description: The point's options as applied in the initial configuration, or extended through Point.update. In TypeScript you have to extend PointOptionsObject via an additional interface to allow custom data options: declare interface PointOptionsObject { customProperty: string; }

name: Point--percentage
title: percentage
description: The percentage for points in a stacked series, pies or gauges.

name: Point--plotX
title: plotX
description: The translated X value for the point in terms of pixels. Relative to the X axis position if the series has one, otherwise relative to the plot area. Depending on the series type this value might not be defined. In an inverted chart the x-axis is going from the bottom to the top so the plotX value is the number of pixels from the bottom of the axis.

name: Point--plotY
title: plotY
description: The translated Y value for the point in terms of pixels. Relative to the Y axis position if the series has one, otherwise relative to the plot area. Depending on the series type this value might not be defined. In an inverted chart the y-axis is going from right to left so the plotY value is the number of pixels from the right of the yAxis.

name: Point--points
title: points
description: Array of all hovered points when using shared tooltips.

name: Point--properties
title: properties
description: In Highcharts Maps, when data is loaded from GeoJSON, the GeoJSON item's properties are copied over here.

name: Point--selected
title: selected
description: Whether the point is selected or not.

name: Point--series
title: series
description: The series object associated with the point.

name: Point--shapeArgs
title: shapeArgs
description: The attributes of the rendered SVG shape like in column or pie series.

name: Point--sliced
title: sliced
description: Pie series only. Whether to display a slice offset from the center.

name: Point--tooltipPos
title: tooltipPos
description: Defines the tooltip's position for a data point in a chart. It is an array of numbers representing the coordinates for the tooltip's placement, allowing for precise control over its location.

name: Point--total
title: total
description: The total of values in either a stack for stacked series, or a pie in a pie series.

name: Point--visible
title: visible
description: For certain series types, like pie charts, where individual points can be shown or hidden.

name: Point--x
title: x
description: The x value of the point.

name: Point--y
title: y
description: The y value of the point.

name: Point--doDrilldown
title: doDrilldown
description: Perform drilldown on a point instance. The drilldown property must be set on the point options. To drill down multiple points in the same category, use Axis.drilldownCategory instead.

name: Point--getClassName
title: getClassName
description: Get the CSS class names for individual points. Used internally where the returned value is set on every point.

name: Point--getZone
title: getZone
description: In a series with zones, return the zone that the point belongs to.

name: Point--haloPath
title: haloPath
description: Get the path definition for the halo, which is usually a shadow-like circle around the currently hovered point.

name: Point--onMouseOut
title: onMouseOut
description: Runs on mouse out from the point. Called internally from mouse and touch events.

name: Point--onMouseOver
title: onMouseOver
description: Runs on mouse over the point. Called internally from mouse and touch events.

name: Point--optionsToObject
title: optionsToObject
description: Transform number or array configs into objects. Also called for object configs. Used internally to unify the different configuration formats for points. For example, a simple number 10 in a line series will be transformed to { y: 10 }, and an array config like [1, 10] in a scatter series will be transformed to { x: 1, y: 10 }.

name: Point--pos
title: pos
description: Get the pixel position of the point relative to the plot area.

name: Point--remove
title: remove
description: Remove a point and optionally redraw the series and if necessary the axes

name: Point--select
title: select
description: Toggle the selection status of a point.

name: Point--setNestedProperty
title: setNestedProperty
description: Set a value in an object, on the property defined by key. The key supports nested properties using dot notation. The function modifies the input object and does not make a copy. Paths containing __proto__ or constructor are ignored.

name: Point--setState
title: setState
description: Set the point's state.

name: Point--setVisible
title: setVisible
description: Toggle the visibility of a pie slice or other data point. Note that this method is available only for some series, like pie, treemap and sunburst.

name: Point--sonify
title: sonify
description: Play a sonification of a point.

name: Point--tooltipFormatter
title: tooltipFormatter
description: Extendable method for formatting each point's tooltip line.

name: Point--update
title: update
description: Update point with new options (typically x/y data) and optionally redraw the series.

name: Series--center
title: center
description: The series center position, read only. This applies only to circular chart types like pie and sunburst. It is an array of [centerX, centerY, diameter, innerDiameter].

name: Series--chart
title: chart
description: Read only. The chart that the series belongs to.

name: Series--color
title: color
description: Series color as used by the legend and some series types.

name: Series--data
title: data
description: Read only. An array containing those values converted to points. In case the series data length exceeds the cropThreshold, or if the data is grouped, series.data doesn't contain all the points. Also, in case a series is hidden, the data array may be empty. In case of cropping, the data array may contain undefined values, instead of points. To access raw values, series.options.data will always be up to date. Series.data only contains the points that have been created on demand. To modify the data, use Highcharts.Series#setData or Highcharts.Point#update.

name: Series--dataMax
title: dataMax
description: Contains the maximum value of the series' data point. Some series types like networkgraph do not support this property as they lack a y-value.

name: Series--dataMin
title: dataMin
description: Contains the minimum value of the series' data point. Some series types like networkgraph do not support this property as they lack a y-value.

name: Series--group
title: group
description: The main group for the series' graphics.

name: Series--index
title: index
description: Contains the series' index in the Chart.series array.

name: Series--legendItem
title: legendItem
description: Legend data for the series.

name: Series--linkedParent
title: linkedParent
description: The parent series of the current series, if the current series has a linkedTo setting.

name: Series--linkedSeries
title: linkedSeries
description: All child series that are linked to the current series through the linkedTo option.

name: Series--name
title: name
description: The series name as given in the options. Defaults to "Series {n}".

name: Series--options
title: options
description: Read only. The series' current options. To update, use Highcharts.Series#update.

name: Series--points
title: points
description: An array containing all currently visible point objects. In case of cropping, the cropped-away points are not part of this array. The series.points array starts at series.cropStart compared to series.data and series.options.data. If however the series data is grouped, these can't be correlated one to one. To modify the data, use Highcharts.Series#setData or Highcharts.Point#update.

name: Series--selected
title: selected
description: Read only. The series' selected state as set by Highcharts.Series#select.

name: Series--type
title: type
description: Read only. The series' type, like "line", "area", "column" etc. The type in the series options anc can be altered using Highcharts.Series#update.

name: Series--userOptions
title: userOptions
description: Contains series options by the user without defaults.

name: Series--visible
title: visible
description: Read only. The series' visibility state as set by Highcharts.Series#show, Highcharts.Series#hide, or in the initial configuration. True by default.

name: Series--xAxis
title: xAxis
description: Read only. The unique xAxis object associated with the series.

name: Series--yAxis
title: yAxis
description: Read only. The unique yAxis object associated with the series.

name: Series--types
title: types
description: Registry of all available series types.

name: Series--addPoint
title: addPoint
description: Add a point to the series after render time. The point can be added at the end, or by giving it an X value, to the start or in the middle of the series. Alternatively, when the chart is using data table for the data, a point can be added by running dataTable.setRow.

name: Series--animate
title: animate
description: Animate in the series. Called internally twice. First with the init parameter set to true, which sets up the initial state of the animation. Then when ready, it is called with the init parameter undefined, in order to perform the actual animation.

name: Series--drawPoints
title: drawPoints
description: Draw the markers for line-like series types, and columns or other graphical representation for Highcharts.Point objects for other series types. The resulting element is typically stored as Highcharts.Point#graphic, and is created on the first call and updated and moved on subsequent calls.

name: Series--getName
title: getName
description: Return the name for the series. Looks for a name in the options. If not found, looks for a column name in the data mapping. If not found, returns a default name based on the series type and index in Series {n}" format. This method can be simply overridden as series name format can vary (e.g. technical indicators).

name: Series--getPlotBox
title: getPlotBox
description: Get the translation and scale for the plot area of this series.

name: Series--getValidPoints
title: getValidPoints
description: Return the series points with null points filtered out.

name: Series--groupData
title: groupData
description: Highcharts Stock only. Takes parallel arrays of x and y data and groups the data into intervals defined by groupPositions, a collection of starting x values for each group.

name: Series--hide
title: hide
description: Hide the series if visible. If the chart.ignoreHiddenSeries option is true, the chart is redrawn without this series.

name: Series--is
title: is
description: Check whether the series item is itself or inherits from a certain series type.

name: Series--markerAttribs
title: markerAttribs
description: Get non-presentational attributes for a point. Used internally for both styled mode and classic. Can be overridden for different series types.

name: Series--onMouseOut
title: onMouseOut
description: Runs on mouse out of the series graphical items.

name: Series--onMouseOver
title: onMouseOver
description: Runs on mouse over the series graphical items.

name: Series--remove
title: remove
description: Remove a series and optionally redraw the chart.

name: Series--removePoint
title: removePoint
description: Remove a point from the series. Unlike the Highcharts.Point#remove method, this can also be done on a point that is not instantiated because it is outside the view or subject to Highcharts Stock data grouping.

name: Series--render
title: render
description: Render the graph and markers. Called internally when first rendering and later when redrawing the chart. This function can be extended in plugins, but normally shouldn't be called directly.

name: Series--searchPoint
title: searchPoint
description: Find the nearest point from a pointer event. This applies to series that use k-d-trees to get the nearest point. Native pointer events must be normalized using Pointer.normalize, that adds chartX and chartY properties.

name: Series--select
title: select
description: Select or unselect the series. This means its selected property is set, the checkbox in the legend is toggled and when selected, the series is returned by the Highcharts.Chart#getSelectedSeries function.

name: Series--setData
title: setData
description: Apply a new set of data to the series and optionally redraw it. The new data array is passed by reference (except in case of updatePoints), and may later be mutated when updating the chart data. Note the difference in behavior when setting the same amount of points, or a different amount of points, as handled by the updatePoints parameter.

name: Series--setState
title: setState
description: Set the state of the series. Called internally on mouse interaction operations, but it can also be called directly to visually highlight a series.

name: Series--setVisible
title: setVisible
description: Show or hide the series.

name: Series--show
title: show
description: Show the series if hidden.

name: Series--sonify
title: sonify
description: Play a sonification of a series.

name: Series--translate
title: translate
description: Translate data points from raw data values to chart specific positioning data needed later in the drawPoints and drawGraph functions. This function can be overridden in plugins and custom series type implementations.

name: Series--update
title: update
description: Update the series with a new set of options. For a clean and precise handling of new options, all methods and elements from the series are removed, and it is initialized from scratch. Therefore, this method is more performance expensive than some other utility methods like Highcharts.Series#setData or Highcharts.Series#setVisible. Note that Series.update may mutate the passed data options.

name: Series--registerType
title: registerType
description: Registers a series class to be accessible via Series.types.

name: Renderer--SVGRenderer
title: SVGRenderer
params: (HTMLElement container, Number width, Number height, [CSSObject style], [Boolean forExport], [Boolean allowHTML], [Boolean styledMode])
description: Allows direct access to the Highcharts rendering layer in order to draw primitive shapes like circles, rectangles, paths or text directly on a chart, or independent from any chart. The SVGRenderer represents a wrapper object for SVG in modern browsers. An existing chart's renderer can be accessed through Highcharts.Chart.renderer. The renderer can also be used completely decoupled from a chart. See How to use the SVG Renderer for a comprehensive tutorial.

name: Renderer--Element
title: Element
description: A pointer to the renderer's associated Element class.

name: Renderer--box
title: box
description: The root svg node of the renderer.

name: Renderer--boxWrapper
title: boxWrapper
description: The wrapper for the root svg node of the renderer.

name: Renderer--defs
title: defs
description: A pointer to the defs node of the root SVG.

name: Renderer--escapes
title: escapes
description: A collection of characters mapped to HTML entities. When useHTML on an element is true, these entities will be rendered correctly by HTML. In the SVG pseudo-HTML, they need to be unescaped back to simple characters, so for example < will render as <.

name: Renderer--forExport
title: forExport
description: Whether the rendered content is intended for export.

name: Renderer--symbols
title: symbols
description: An extendable collection of functions for defining symbol paths. Each symbol function takes five parameters: x, y, width, height and options, and returns an SVGPath array.

name: Renderer--arc
title: arc
params: (Number x, [Number y], [Number r], [Number innerR], [Number start], [Number end])
description: Draw and return an arc.

name: Renderer--arc
title: arc
description: Draw and return an arc. Overloaded function that takes arguments object.

name: Renderer--button
title: button
params: (String text, Number x, Number y, Function callback, [Object theme], [Object hoverState], [Object selectState], [Object disabledState], [String shape], [Boolean useHTML])
description: Create a button with preset states. Styles for the button can either be set as arguments, or a general theme for all buttons can be set by the global.buttonTheme option.

name: Renderer--circle
title: circle
description: Draw a circle, wraps the SVG circle element.

name: Renderer--circle
title: circle
description: Draw a circle, wraps the SVG circle element.

name: Renderer--clipRect
title: clipRect
description: Define a clipping rectangle. The clipping rectangle is later applied to Highcharts.SVGElement objects through the Highcharts.SVGElement#clip function. This function is deprecated as of v11.2. Instead, use a regular shape (rect, path etc), and the SVGElement.clipTo function.

name: Renderer--createElement
title: createElement
description: Create a wrapper for an SVG element. Serves as a factory for Highcharts.SVGElement, but this function is itself mostly called from primitive factories like Highcharts.SVGRenderer#path, Highcharts.SVGRenderer#rect or Highcharts.SVGRenderer#text.

name: Renderer--crispLine
title: crispLine
description: Make a straight line crisper by not spilling out to neighbor pixels.

name: Renderer--definition
title: definition
description: General method for adding a definition to the SVG defs tag. Can be used for gradients, fills, filters etc. Styled mode only. A hook for adding general definitions to the SVG's defs tag. Definitions can be referenced from the CSS by its id. Read more in gradients, shadows and patterns. Styled mode only.

name: Renderer--destroy
title: destroy
description: Destroys the renderer and its allocated members.

name: Renderer--draw
title: draw
description: Dummy function for plugins, called every time the renderer is updated. Prior to Highcharts 5, this was used for the canvg renderer.

name: Renderer--fontMetrics
title: fontMetrics
description: Utility to return the baseline offset and total line height from the font size.

name: Renderer--g
title: g
description: Create and return an svg group element. Child Highcharts.SVGElement objects are added to the group by using the group as the first parameter in add().

name: Renderer--getContrast
title: getContrast
description: Returns white for dark colors and black for bright colors, based on W3C's definition of Relative luminance.

name: Renderer--image
title: image
params: (String href, [Number x], [Number y], [Number width], [Number height], [Function onload])
description: Display an image.

name: Renderer--init
title: init
params: (HTMLElement container, Number width, Number height, [CSSObject style], [Boolean forExport], [Boolean allowHTML], [Boolean styledMode])
description: Initialize the SVGRenderer. Overridable initializer function that takes the same parameters as the constructor.

name: Renderer--isHidden
title: isHidden
description: Detect whether the renderer is hidden. This happens when one of the parent elements has display: none. Used internally to detect when we need to render preliminarily in another div to get the text bounding boxes right.

name: Renderer--label
title: label
params: (String str, Number x, [Number y], [String shape], [Number anchorX], [Number anchorY], [Boolean useHTML], [Boolean baseline], [String className])
description: Draw a label, which is an extended text element with support for border and background. Highcharts creates a g element with a text and a path or rect inside, to make it behave somewhat like a HTML div. Border and background are set through stroke, stroke-width and fill attributes using the attr method. To update the text after render, run label.attr({ text: 'New text' }).

name: Renderer--path
title: path
description: Draw a path, wraps the SVG path element.

name: Renderer--rect
title: rect
params: (Number x, [Number y], [Number width], [Number height], [Number r], [Number strokeWidth])
description: Draw and return a rectangle.

name: Renderer--rect
title: rect
description: Draw and return a rectangle.

name: Renderer--roundedRect
title: roundedRect
description: Draw and return a rectangle with advanced corner rounding options.

name: Renderer--setSize
title: setSize
description: Resize the Highcharts.SVGRenderer#box and re-align all aligned child elements.

name: Renderer--setStyle
title: setStyle
description: Apply the global style on the renderer, mixed with the default styles.

name: Renderer--symbol
title: symbol
params: (String symbol, [Number x], [Number y], [Number width], [Number height], [Object options])
description: Draw a symbol out of pre-defined shape paths from Highcharts.SVGRenderer#symbols. It is used in Highcharts for point makers, which cake a symbol option, and label and button backgrounds like in the tooltip and stock flags.

name: Renderer--text
title: text
description: Draw text. The text can contain a subset of HTML, like spans and anchors and some basic text styling of these. For more advanced features like border and background, use Highcharts.SVGRenderer#label instead. To update the text after render, run text.attr({ text: 'New text' }).

name: Element--SVGElement
title: SVGElement
description: The SVGElement prototype is a JavaScript wrapper for SVG elements used in the rendering layer of Highcharts. Combined with the Highcharts.SVGRenderer object, these prototypes allow freeform annotation in the charts or even in HTML pages without instantiating a chart. The SVGElement can also wrap HTML labels, when text or label elements are created with the useHTML parameter. The SVGElement instances are created through factory functions on the Highcharts.SVGRenderer object, like rect, path, text, label, g and more. See How to use the SVG Renderer for a comprehensive tutorial on how to draw SVG elements on a chart.

name: Element--element
title: element
description: The primary DOM node. Each SVGElement instance wraps a main DOM node, but may also represent more nodes.

name: Element--renderer
title: renderer
description: The renderer that the SVGElement belongs to.

name: Element--add
title: add
description: Add the element to the DOM. All elements must be added this way.

name: Element--addClass
title: addClass
description: Add a class name to an element.

name: Element--align
title: align
description: Align the element relative to the chart or another box.

name: Element--animate
title: animate
description: Animate to given attributes or CSS properties.

name: Element--attr
title: attr
description: Apply native and custom attributes to the SVG elements. In order to set the rotation center for rotation, set x and y to 0 and use translateX and translateY attributes to position the element instead. Attributes frequently used in Highcharts are fill, stroke, stroke-width.

name: Element--clip
title: clip
description: Apply a clipping shape to this element.

name: Element--crisp
title: crisp
description: Calculate the coordinates needed for drawing a rectangle crisply and return the calculated attributes.

name: Element--css
title: css
description: Set styles for the element. In addition to CSS styles supported by native SVG and HTML elements, there are also some custom made for Highcharts, like width, ellipsis and textOverflow for SVG text elements.

name: Element--destroy
title: destroy
description: Destroy the element and element wrapper and clear up the DOM and event hooks.

name: Element--fadeIn
title: fadeIn
description: A general fadeIn method.

name: Element--getBBox
title: getBBox
description: Get the bounding box (width, height, x and y) for the element. Generally used to get rendered text size. Since this is called a lot in charts, the results are cached based on text properties, in order to save DOM traffic. The returned bounding box includes the rotation, so for example a single text line of rotation 90 will report a greater height, and a width corresponding to the line-height.

name: Element--getBBoxCacheKey
title: getBBoxCacheKey
description: Overridable method to get a cache key for the bounding box of this element.

name: Element--getStyle
title: getStyle
description: Get the computed style. Only in styled mode.

name: Element--hasClass
title: hasClass
description: Check if an element has the given class name.

name: Element--hide
title: hide
description: Hide the element, similar to setting the visibility attribute to hidden.

name: Element--init
title: init
description: Initialize the SVG element. This function only exists to make the initialization process overridable. It should not be called directly.

name: Element--on
title: on
description: Add an event listener. This is a simple setter that replaces the previous event of the same type added by this function, as opposed to the Highcharts#addEvent function.

name: Element--removeClass
title: removeClass
description: Remove a class name from the element.

name: Element--setRadialReference
title: setRadialReference
description: Set the coordinates needed to draw a consistent radial gradient across a shape regardless of positioning inside the chart. Used on pie slices to make all the slices have the same radial reference point.

name: Element--shadow
title: shadow
description: Add a shadow to the element. In styled mode, this method is not used, instead use defs and filters.

name: Element--show
title: show
description: Show the element after it has been hidden.

name: Element--strokeWidth
title: strokeWidth
description: Get the computed stroke width in pixel values. This is used extensively when drawing shapes to ensure the shapes are rendered crisp and positioned correctly relative to each other. Using shape-rendering: crispEdges leaves us less control over positioning, for example when we want to stack columns next to each other, or position things pixel-perfectly within the plot box. The common pattern when placing a shape is: Create the SVGElement and add it to the DOM. In styled mode, it will now receive a stroke width from the style sheet. In classic mode we will add the stroke-width attribute. Read the computed elem.strokeWidth(). Place it based on the stroke width.

name: Element--toFront
title: toFront
description: Bring the element to the front. Alternatively, a new zIndex can be set.

name: Element--translate
title: translate
description: Move an object and its children by x and y values.
